item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 28/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will affect the region. With the southwesterly airstream becoming active, the weather will remain unsettled over the coast of southern China midweek this week to early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Co-May will linger over the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands at first today, and then move across the East China Sea in the following couple of days.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and thunderstorms. Very hot with sunny intervals during the day. More showers later.
